review_comments: Is this going to work with hot-reload?

If hot reload can change the information that is cached here, then we need a way to either disable this, or a way to invalidate the cache. There is already a cache with some entries which could be affected by this.

There's an issue https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/50978 to add a MetadataUpdateHandler for mono to clear reflection caches.  (we also have caching in native that we need to clear, and that's not done yet, too). /cc @fanyang-mono
